in_marathi.name: Manak
in_marathi.long_meaning: Manak हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Manak is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'mānak', which means moon. This name is associated with the lunar deity and symbolizes coolness, purity, and reflection.
